# sfcompute_instances (Data Source)

Reads instances from SF Compute (`GET /v2/instances`). All pages are fetched unless `limit`, `starting_after` or `ending_before` is set.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sfcompute_instances" "running" {
  status = ["running"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `created_after` (Number) Filter to instances created at or after this Unix timestamp (seconds).
- `created_before` (Number) Filter to instances created at or before this Unix timestamp (seconds).
- `ending_before` (String) Cursor for backward pagination.
- `id` (List of String) Filter by instance ID (repeatable).
- `limit` (Number)
- `pool` (List of String) Filter by pool (repeatable). Instances on any of the given pools match.
- `sku` (List of String) Filter by SKU id (repeatable; any id spelling is accepted). Instances on any of the given SKUs match.
- `starting_after` (String) Cursor for forward pagination (from a previous response's `cursor` field).
- `status` (List of String) Filter by instance status (repeatable).
- `subnet` (List of String) Filter by subnet (ID or resource path; repeatable). Instances on any of the given subnets match.
- `tag` (List of String) Filter by tag key-value pair (repeatable). Format: `key=value` (the `=` between key and value must be percent-encoded in the URL).
- `tag_key` (List of String) Filter by tag key existence (repeatable). Returns resources that have a tag with this key, regardless of the value.
- `workspace` (String) Scope the returned list to a single workspace (ID, resource path, or name). Without it, the returned list spans every workspace where the caller has `Instance:List` and `Instance:Read` (granted at either the workspace or organization level). If omitted, the provider's `workspace` is used.

### Read-Only

- `cursor` (String) Pass as `starting_after` or `ending_before` to paginate.
- `data` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))
- `has_more` (Boolean)

<a id="nestedatt--data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data`

Read-Only:

- `_preview_enable_public_ipv4` (Boolean) **Preview.** Whether this instance requires a public IPv4 address. When `false`, only SSH (TCP port 22) is open on the instance and no other ports accept inbound traffic.
- `_preview_firewall` (String) **Preview.** Firewall attached to this instance's public IP. Omitted when the instance has `_preview_enable_public_ipv4 = false`.
- `_preview_infiniband_partition` (String) **Preview.** InfiniBand partition this instance is a member of, if any. Set at create time and fixed for the instance's lifetime.
- `_preview_public_ip` (String) **Preview.** Public IPv4 address assigned to this instance. Present only when `_preview_enable_public_ipv4 = true`; omitted otherwise.
- `_preview_updated_at` (Number) Unix timestamp (seconds) when the instance was last updated.
- `cloud_init_user_data_used` (Boolean) Whether cloud-init user data is configured for this instance. Fetch the data itself from `GET /instances/{id}/cloud_init_user_data`.
- `created_at` (Number) Unix timestamp.
- `id` (String)
- `image` (Attributes) Image this instance was launched from. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--image))
- `managed_by` (Attributes) Deployment or spot deployment managing this instance, if any. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--managed_by))
- `name` (String)
- `pool` (Attributes) Pool this instance is utilizing. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--pool))
- `priority_level` (String) Instance priority. Lower-priority instances are terminated first when the capacity's quota drops below the running-instance count.
- `private_ip` (String) Private IPv4 address assigned to this instance within its subnet, if any.
- `resource_path` (String) A resource path for a instance resource. Format: sfc:instance:<account>:<workspace>:<name>.
- `sku` (Attributes) SKU this instance is pinned to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--sku))
- `state` (String) `awaiting_allocation` when waiting for compute allocation on its capacity, `running` once assigned and the physical machine is running (still takes time for the image to be downloaded and booted), `terminated` when stopped by the user or after running out of allocation, `failed` on hardware fault.

Values are not exhaustive across API versions. Clients should tolerate new statuses.
- `subnet` (String) Subnet this instance is placed in, if any. Instances without a subnet use an ephemeral subnet (isolated, no east-west traffic with other VMs).
- `tags` (Map of String) Metadata tags attached to this instance.
- `workspace` (Attributes) Workspace this instance belongs to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--workspace))
